name: com.footballpricer.www/oracle
title: FootballPricer Probability Oracle
description: Calibrated football probability oracle, +EV/Kelly edges, and <10ms Polymarket market re-pricer.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Retrieve FootballPricer historical verified calibration track record (ROI%, CLV%, and Brier Score vs sharp closing market). Public and free (0 credits). Call this first to audit oracle calibration.

league.description: Optional league name filter, e.g. 'Premier League'

includeRecentPicks.description: Number of most recent settled picks to return (0..50).

tools.name: list_upcoming_edges
tools.description: List pre-computed upcoming football matches in EPL, Serie A, La Liga, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, and UCL. Use detail="discovery" (0 credits) to browse fixtures & stability, or detail="full" (1 credit / $0.01) to include top +EV picks and offered odds.

league.description: Optional league filter, e.g. 'Premier League' or 'UEFA Champions League'.

stabilityFilter.description: Filter matches by model stability tier.

onlyActionable.description: When true (default), exclude watchlist and stake-gated matches.

detail.description: Use discovery (0 credits) or full (1 credit) to include +EV picks and offered odds.

limit.description: Maximum number of upcoming matches to return (1..100).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate credit charges on retries.

tools.name: get_match_pricing
tools.description: Get compact calibrated probabilities (1X2, Asian Handicap, Goals O/U, BTTS), fair odds, EV%, Fractional Kelly sizing, and stability flags. Costs 5 credits ($0.05) on pre-warmed cache hit, or 50 credits ($0.50) if allowFreshRun=true triggers a cold pipeline run (auto-refunded on failure).

slateId.description: Pre-computed slate run ID from list_upcoming_edges.

homeTeam.description: Home team name (used if slateId is omitted).

awayTeam.description: Away team name (used if slateId is omitted).

allowFreshRun.description: Allow starting an asynchronous cold pricing job (50 credits) on cache miss.

includeTacticalBrief.description: Include concise tactical analysis and counter-thesis notes.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate credit charges on retries.

tools.name: get_pricing_job
tools.description: Poll an asynchronous cold pricing job started by get_match_pricing. Free (0 credits).

jobId.description: Job ID returned by get_match_pricing when allowFreshRun=true.

includeTacticalBrief.description: Include tactical analysis notes once the job completes.

tools.name: reprice_live_odds
tools.description: Deterministic <10ms Dixon-Coles re-pricer (1 credit / $0.01). Default mode="quote_only" evaluates live Polymarket/Kalshi probability shares (0.01..0.99) or decimal odds against fixed model probabilities with slippage & commission without distorting the sharp prior. Use mode="reanchor_market" for sharp closing odds or late injury shocks.

slateId.description: Pre-computed slate run ID to reprice.

homeTeam.description: Home team name if resolving without slateId.

awayTeam.description: Away team name if resolving without slateId.

league.description: Competition name if resolving without slateId.

matchDate.description: Match date (YYYY-MM-DD) if resolving without slateId.

mode.description: quote_only evaluates market quotes cleanly; reanchor_market re-anchors sharp odds and team shocks.

quotes.description: Array of 1 to 12 live market quotes to evaluate.

format.description: Quote format: decimal odds (>1.01) or probability_share (0.01..0.99).

slippageBps.description: Estimated execution slippage in basis points (0..1000).

commissionPct.description: Exchange/market fee percentage on net profit (0..15).

reanchorSharpOdds.description: Optional sharp closing bookmaker decimal odds when mode=reanchor_market.

ahHome.description: Sharp decimal home Asian Handicap odds.

ahAway.description: Sharp decimal away Asian Handicap odds.

shocks.description: Optional expected-goal lambda adjustments (%) for late team news when mode=reanchor_market.

tempoDeltaPct.description: Match tempo / total goals delta percentage.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate credit charges on retries.
